subject: Springboard rollout charter & sprint-zero deliverables
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@springboard.ai>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@springboard.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-01T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Springboard rollout charter & sprint-zero deliverables

Emily / Rajesh —

Thanks for the time today. Per our call I wanted to capture a compact rollout charter and the sprint-zero deliverables so we have a single source of truth for kickoff. Attached is the first draft of the MAP and an SOW stub for internal review (Springboard_MAP_v1.xlsx, RBW_SOW_draft.pdf).

High-level objective: Go-live for inference integration in PRD by 2028-01-15 with staged traffic ramp and SOC2 evidence in place for procurement sign-off.

Sprint‑Zero (week of 2027-11-13) — goals and owners:
- Access & network baseline (due 2027-11-15) — Owner: Lauren Bishop (Redwood).
- Security questionnaire + evidence list (due 2027-11-17) — Owner: Soojin Lee (Redwood), deliverable: compliance-evidence-list.xlsx.
- Initial model selection & inference cadence (due 2027-11-20) — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood), input: Springboard usage profile.
- Dev/test workspace ready (due 2027-11-22) — Owner: Springboard Eng (Rajesh).

Milestone map (high level):
1) Sprint‑Zero complete — 2027-11-22 — gate: VPN + test tokens provisioned.
2) Pilot (limited traffic, validation) — 2027-12-15 — gate: performance SLOs met.
3) Go‑live (gradual ramp) — 2028-01-15 — gate: procurement sign-off + DocuSign executed.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the right security contact for itemized evidence? (Emily / Procurement)
- Please confirm Rajesh's lead dev availability the week of 11/13 for a 2-hour kickoff.

Next step: I'll update the MAP with any changes and share a Drive folder. If this looks good I’ll propose a brief kickoff (30–45m) on Monday 11/13 10am PT.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Springboard_MAP_v1.xlsx, RBW_SOW_draft.pdf

From: Emily Park <emily.park@springboard.ai>

Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.k@springboard.ai>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Springboard rollout charter & sprint-zero deliverables

Ben —

Thanks for the concise plan and for pulling the MAP together. A few quick items from procurement/security before we commit to dates: we need SOC2 Type II confirmation or equivalent artifact and a short matrix mapping which customer data is sent to Redwood (PII/no-PII). Procurement also asked if the security evidence list can be delivered by 11/15 instead of 11/17 — they are trying to align internal review cycles.

Rajesh is available for a kickoff on 11/13 but prefers a 60-minute block early in the day to align the infra and app teams. Can you do 11/13 9am PT instead? If not, what other slots exist that week.

One other ask: can you add a single owner for validation testing (integration smoke tests)? We’ll assign an internal QA lead but would like Redwood to own the smoke test checklist.

Appended below for context:

Subject: Fwd: Springboard rollout charter & sprint-zero deliverables (internal notes)

Ben / Lauren —

Looping internal owners with a couple adjustments based on Emily's procurement ask. Forwarding Emily's reply below for quick context.

Internal action updates (plan to reflect in MAP v1.1):
- Move security evidence deliverable to 2027-11-15. Owner: Soojin Lee. I will collect SOC2 artifacts and a short mapping of data flows by that date.
- Add a Redwood-owned smoke test checklist (deliverable: rbw-smoke-checklist.md) — Owner: Lauren Bishop. Target for checklist draft: 2027-11-18.
- Kickoff: propose 11/13 9:00–10:00 PT to accommodate Rajesh; Ben to confirm with Emily.

Internal note: I’ll coordinate with security engineering to assemble minimal redacted logs and sample KV cache behavior notes for compliance. We should avoid shipping full logs — just the evidence table.

Subject: Re: Springboard rollout charter & sprint-zero deliverables — updated MAP v1.1

Emily / Rajesh / Procurement —

Thanks — we updated the MAP based on the asks and attached v1.1. Quick summary of changes and confirmed slots:  

Confirmed kickoff: 2027-11-13, 9:00–10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).
Updated sprint-zero deliverables (owners & dates):
- Security evidence & SOC2 artifacts — 2027-11-15 — Owner: Soojin Lee (Redwood). Attachment: compliance-evidence-list.xlsx (redacted index).
- Smoke test checklist (Redwood) — 2027-11-18 — Owner: Lauren Bishop. Deliverable: rbw-smoke-checklist.md (draft in Drive).
- Network & access confirmation — 2027-11-15 — Owner: Lauren Bishop (Redwood).
- Dev/test workspace ready — 2027-11-22 — Owner: Rajesh Kumar (Springboard).

Pilot & go‑live cadence remains the same (Pilot target 2027-12-15, Go-live ramp 2028-01-15) but we added an explicit procurement gate requiring DocuSign execution before any production traffic is permitted.

Next steps (short list):
1) Ben: share updated MAP v1.1 in Drive and push invite. (done)
2) Soojin: upload redacted SOC2 index and evidence list to Drive by 11/15.
3) Lauren: draft smoke test checklist 11/18 and coordinate QA acceptance criteria.
4) Rajesh: confirm dev/test environment access and tokens by 11/22.
